india.one_line: India's AI landscape sees corporate growth, regulatory tools, financing needs, and new school curriculum.

themes.title: Infosys AI revenue rises, outlook cut
themes.text: Infosys reported AI revenue grew 29% QoQ, now 10.5% of total, but lowered FY27 constant‑currency growth guidance to 1‑2% amid softer demand.

stories.headline: Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%

themes.title: SEBI rolls out AI sandbox
themes.text: SEBI announced a graded broker compliance framework, an AI sandbox for testing tools, and a market‑making mechanism for tokenised corporate bonds.

stories.headline: SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: AI sector seeks debt for data centres
themes.text: A Union Bank of India report says Indian AI firms will increasingly use debt financing to build data centres, citing rapid GPU obsolescence, limited domestic hardware, and evolving regulations as risks.

stories.headline: India's AI sector looks to debt financing for data centres amid GPU and regulatory risks

themes.title: NCERT launches AI curriculum
themes.text: NCERT introduced a 20‑hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9‑12, developed with IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur, covering machine learning, deepfake detection, data privacy and ethical AI.

stories.headline: NCERT releases 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9-12
